values.meaning: duration of the Power Chord bonus damage tag/window
values.quote: on their next attack {{tip|on-hit}} within 5 seconds

mechanics.claim: Q hits the two nearest visible enemies, prioritizing champions, each taking magic damage as area damage.
mechanics.quote: sends out bolts of sound to the two nearest {{tip|sight|visible}} enemies, prioritizing champions

mechanics.claim: Sona gains a Power Chord (Accelerando) stack for each bolt that hits an enemy champion.
mechanics.quote: '''Sona''' gains a stack of ''{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Accelerando}}'' for each bolt that hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}

mechanics.claim: The Power Chord empowered attack deals bonus on-hit magic damage as proc damage rather than area damage.
mechanics.quote: the {{sbc|{{ai|Power Chord|Sona|Melody|image=*none*}}}} empowered attacks deal {{tip|proc damage}}

mechanics.claim: The empowered attack triggers against wards but is not consumed by them.
mechanics.quote: The empowered attack will trigger but not be consumed against [[ward]]s.
